modelOverview: The Tank Must Medium sits below the Large model in Cartier's 2021 revival of the Must de Cartier line, cased at 29.5mm x 22mm in steel with a compact, elegant profile suited to smaller wrists. It is powered by Cartier's photovoltaic SolarBeat movement, a light-charged quartz calibre that never needs a battery change, and pairs a silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands with an interchangeable leather strap or steel bracelet.

WSTA0060.description: The WSTA0060 is the standard Medium-sized Tank Must, introduced in 2021 with Cartier's photovoltaic SolarBeat movement in place of a conventional battery. Its compact 29.5mm x 22mm steel case carries the model's classic silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands on an interchangeable strap made without animal materials. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
